name: n8n
summary: Node-based automation you can host yourself, now with AI agent, model and memory nodes in the same canvas.
description:
n8n's strength is that the workflow, the branching and the credentials live where you can see and audit them, and self-hosting means an internal automation never has to leave your network. Adding LangChain-backed agent nodes made it a legitimate place to build AI features without writing an orchestration layer, and the connector catalogue is wide enough that most SaaS is one node away.

Licensing is fair-code, not OSI open source, so read what that means before reselling or embedding it. And any visual tool lets a team build fifteen automations nobody owns — the maintenance cost of that is a governance problem, not a product flaw.
